description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ClientTrait' which provides default implementations for various HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.) and their asynchronous counterparts for an HTTP client. It abstracts request creation and sending, relying on concrete classes to implement the 'request' and 'requestAsync' methods. It also imports necessary interfaces and exceptions related to HTTP messaging and promises.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP GET request to the specified URI with optional request options.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP PUT request.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP DELETE request.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an asynchronous HTTP request; must be implemented by concrete classes.

methods.name: getAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP GET request.

methods.name: headAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP HEAD request.

methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PUT request.

methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP POST request.

methods.name: patchAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP PATCH request.

methods.name: deleteAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP DELETE request.
